sample_some_states_sequential_game: sample some states from a sequential pyspiel game with a maximum of 100 states
sample_some_states_simultaneous_game: sample states from a simultaneous game which returns only the initial state
sample_some_states_mean_field_game: sample states from a mean field game with a custom distribution function
sample_some_states_unlimited: sample all reachable states from a sequential game without a maximum limit
sample_some_states_subset_testing: sample a subset of game states for testing predicates on large games
